texts.zh: 好消息！我们发现[From.GetName]的热带雨林中生长着一种特殊的树，它的果实非常有营养。这种食物含有着惊人的能量以及我们的人民所需的全部营养。这确定无疑地有助于减轻我们殖民这个地方的压力。
texts.en: Good news! We have found the tropical forests of [From.GetName] to be host to a special kind of tree, blooming with nutritious fruits. The food produced stores tons of energy and contains all the chemicals our people need to function well. This will most assuredly make life a little bit easier to sustain, would we want to colonize.
